name: Sentinelle Errant
description: Sentinelle du dernier relais veillant sur les points de convergence stratégiques entre les zones de conflit.

loadout.armor_outfit: Vêtements usés par le voyage, tons gris-brun, équipement de fortune. Visages marqués par les vents stellaires. Regard perçant., refined faction craftsmanship
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's heal ability (damaged_friendly) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Epic combat manifestation character unleashing their signature ability at maximum power with full body commitment — Healing energy seeking out damaged allies while bypassing healthy targets

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Dusty Steel Gray
palette_names.role: primary_accent — weathered clothing and armor base

palette_names.name: Warm Amber
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — lantern light, eye highlights, tool glints

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multi-source dramatic lighting: primary glow from the ability effect itself, secondary rim light, environmental reflections from below

camera.angle: low extreme angle with wide lens emphasizing the character's dominance over the environment

scenography.setting: Asteroid waystation at the edge of known space, corrugated metal walls scarred by micrometeorite impacts, flickering plasma lanterns casting long shadows on rusted bulkheads
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Fine stellar dust floating in dim light, distant nebula glow through cracked observation windows, scattered debris suggesting transience, plus triage effect — tendrils of light finding the wounded among the healthy visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Sentinelle du dernier relais veillant sur les points de convergence stratégiques entre les zones de conflit.
card_metadata.faction_lore: Les Neutres sont les observateurs éternels du conflit interstellaire. Ils survivent dans les zones grises du cosmos où aucune faction ne règne.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing with light along the border edges
card_metadata.composition_directive: Wide dramatic shot showing character AND the full environmental scope of their ability's power and reach
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
